changes.title: Take off anywhere
items: With your broom you can take off from any room or branch of the treehouse
Flying over the treehouse's trunk, from the Dining Room up to the Boudoir, lands you on it, clear of the furniture

changes.title: Tall trees
items: Trees stand at their full height again: the tallest giants tower over the canopy
Half as many tall and giant trees as before, so the forest stays quick to draw

changes.title: Conga not leashed
items: After winning an island, the conga line follows you without ever joining your sigil stack
